description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling 'Item' related actions within the Coocook project. It includes methods for setting up item context, converting item units, and updating item offsets, with access control and error handling.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Item
classes.description: Catalyst controller class managing item-related actions such as conversion and offset updates within the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the item context by fetching the item with the given ID and storing it in the stash, or detaching with an error if not found.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Handles POST requests to convert an item's unit, adjusting its value and offset based on unit conversion factors, with validation and redirection.

methods.name: update_offset
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an item's offset, either directly or relative to its current value, with validation and redirection.
